name: Kyoufu! Macho Shuukyou Kan'yuu Onii-san
original_name: 恐怖！マッチョ宗教勧誘おにいさん
source:
Regardless of your dissatisfaction with your current home, you're being relentlessly recruited into a religious cult!
This macho man will try every trick in the book to get you to join, so you'll have to deal with him in every way possible!

✨A Horror Novel Simulation of How to Deal with Religious Recruitment✨

He'll ring the intercom and come over.
Answer or not?
Choose what to do after he answers.
